No account at all? Paste this.

Kilo Code answers in the terminal you already have open — a rate-limited lane to prove this page is live, not a setup to write code on.

curl -s https://api.kilo.ai/api/gateway/chat/completions \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"openrouter/free","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"2+2? MAKE NO MISTAKES."}]}'

Use free IDs without a key; metered IDs require sign-in. kilo-auto/free and openrouter/free choose a free model automatically. LiquidAI advises against agentic coding with lfm-2.5-2.6b.

Ready-made files, regenerated on every update

configs/opencode.json Drop-in opencode config with every provider wired up — keys via {env:…}, keyless endpoints work immediately.
configs/free-llm.env.example Commented env exports for any OpenAI-compatible tool.
configs/claude-code.sh One shell function per gateway that serves the Anthropic Messages format — source it and claude-openrouter-free runs Claude Code on that lane.
configs/litellm.yaml LiteLLM proxy for compatible free models; free/strong or free/nokey switch lanes when one runs out. Start with env -u OPENAI_API_KEY LITELLM_DANGEROUSLY_PERMIT_WEAK_OR_UNSET_MASTER_KEY=true litellm --config configs/litellm.yaml --host 127.0.0.1 to bind to loopback and prevent fallback to your OPENAI_API_KEY. No proxy master key is configured.
configs/codex/litellm.config.toml Codex CLI profile: LiteLLM converts chat completions to the Responses API required by Codex. Run the proxy, copy the file to ~/.codex/, then codex -p litellm (Codex CLI 0.134 and LiteLLM 1.98 or later).
llms.txt The whole list as one text file for LLM search and agents — every live offer with its page, what it needs and where it answers.
index.json The machine-readable registry: every row with its connection details, models, limits and verdicts.
browse.html The same rows as a filterable table — category, no card, no key, OpenAI-compatible, Claude Code route, strong models.
feed.xml Atom feed of every change: rows arriving, rows leaving, free-model lists moving.
providers/ One page per row — the offer in the vendor's own words, the connection details, the evidence the probe reads and the row's history.

📡 How this list stays fresh

A scheduled job calls every provider twice a week and rewrites this page from what it finds — there is no hand-maintained copy of any figure on it.

Live verification

Every row anchors on something that dies with the offer: a model id in the vendor's own /models, or wording on the page that states the free tier. A row that fails 3 probes in a row, or goes 60 days without a pass, drops to the Archive.

The vendor's own words

Limits link to vendor sources. Quotes are checked against those sources; mismatches require review.

Legal free only

Free is by the vendor's own account — a catalog flag, a published price of zero or the vendor's own words on its pricing page. Anything running on pooled consumer accounts, reverse-engineered clients or spoofed apps is refused, and the reason is published with it.

257 services were checked and are not listed — each with the reason on the day it was read and what would change the answer: the whole list of them. Nothing there is disqualified, and every verdict expires after 90 days. Rules, ordering and how to send a row: CONTRIBUTING. A 👁 tag means what you send may be used to train models, by the vendor's own account; the row's page quotes it.A 🧪 new row was added recently on fresh evidence and is provisional until two weeks of probes confirm it.

📦 Archive
